reviews.checked_passages: Syntax: Signatures; Variables, Terms, and Atoms; Formulas. Semantics: Structures, Interpretations, term evaluation and formula truth clauses.
reviews.consumers: [Many-sorted functions and terms](entries/many-sorted-functions/entry.html): typed syntax and semantics; substitution and direct functional reduction receive their own corpus proofs.
reviews.outcome: JUNTTILA-MSL-01 records a local assignment-update subscript typo. No other serious defect established in these selected definitions. Preserve nonempty carriers, function argument/result sorts, and equality only on a common sort. The corpus supplies its own substitution induction and reduction proof; this source does not certify those new arguments. The later Theories and SMT decidability discussion was not adopted.
